scenes.say: Formula One has no DRS any more. So how do drivers overtake now?
Both the front and rear wings now move. Every driver opens them on the straights, every lap.
Be within a second of the car ahead at the detection point, and you get Overtake mode: extra electrical energy.
The electric motor now delivers about half the power, and the battery has to be recharged under braking.
So overtaking has become tactical: where to spend your energy, and where to save it.
Follow every driver's gaps and positions live on LapRadar.

title: Formula 1 without DRS: how overtaking works under the 2026 rules
